title: Oahu Ocean Adventures
specs: 42-foot Lagoon Catamaran with 3 staterooms and 3 bathrooms with showers
Wildlife sightings include green sea turtles, Hawaiian monk seals, spinner dolphins, humpback whales (seasonal), whale sharks, pilot whales, bottlenose dolphins
Friday 3-in-1 cruise includes snorkeling, sunset, and fireworks from the water
Captain Forrest is USCG licensed, certified master diver, freediver, and experienced in marine wildlife
Children under 13 must wear life jackets at all times on the water (US Coast Guard requirement)
No strict minimum age; infants welcome on cruises with guardian; children should be comfortable in water for snorkeling
No swimming skill required but should be comfortable in water; in-water guide stays with snorkelers
Guests with limited mobility can be assisted case-by-case; boat not fully ADA accessible
USCG licensed captain and certified master diver leads tours
Private charters limited to up to 6 guests; call for groups larger than 6

blurb: Guests board a 42-foot Lagoon Catamaran for private charters up to 6 guests. Activities include snorkeling with sea turtles and dolphins, sunset cruises along Waikiki and Diamond Head, whale watching in season, and a unique Friday 3-in-1 cruise with snorkeling, sunset, and fireworks. Trips are customizable in duration and itinerary.
extraNote: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before tour; within 48 hours non-refundable unless operator cancels for weather or safety · If weather unsafe, tour rescheduled or refunded; light rain or overcast usually do not cancel · No refund for cloudy weather on sunset cruise; reschedule or refund if unsafe to depart · No-whale guarantee during whale season; free rebooking if no whales seen · Tips not required but customary 15-20% appreciated; can tip cash or card or Venmo · Ala Wai Boat Harbor – 1 Holomoana St, Honolulu, HI 96815
